items.title: The extension-by-zero Cech complex is a resolution of the image presheaf of the augmentation
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter cohomology.tex (Cohomology of Sheaves), section on the Cech complex
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the homology presheaves of the extension-by-zero Cech complex K(U)_bullet of a covering of a ringed space: they vanish in degrees other than zero and are the image presheaf O_U of the augmentation in degree zero (statement lines 1200-1215). The proof extends the complex by that image presheaf in degree -1 and then works section-wise over an arbitrary open W, splitting the index set according to which U_i contain W, which turns the section complex into a direct sum of copies of O_X(W) with an explicit differential (proof lines 1226-1252). The contractibility is then shown by the explicit homotopy that inserts a fixed index i_fix and cancels against the differential in a displayed computation (proof lines 1253-1283). The two ingredients that have to be supplied by hand are the case split on W and the homotopy itself; nothing is cited beyond the construction of the complex. The claim is H2.
